verdict.rationale: Sierra Insights documents tracking agent performance against CSAT and case resolution in reports, with click-through investigation of any data point (sierra-docs-22, sierra-docs-12/34). Handoff rate and cost per resolution are not shown as dashboard metrics: hand-off rules appear only as an experimentation variable, and outcome-based pricing is a billing model, not a reported metric. Missing for 10: explicit handoff-rate metric, cost-per-resolution reporting, exec-ready dashboard/export details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
